nodes.description: Private address state variable holding the beneficiary of the locked tokens; set in constructor, read in initiateLock, increaseLock (owner check) and release (transfer recipient).
Private bool state variable tracking whether the lock has been initiated; written in initiateLock, read in increaseLock and release.
Private uint256 state variable with the timestamp when tokens become releasable; written in initiateLock/increaseLock and read in unlocked/release.
Constructor of TokenTimelock that assigns the beneficiary argument to _beneficiary.
Public function that starts the timelock: validates caller is the beneficiary and releaseTime is in the future, then writes _releaseTime and _lockInitiated.
Public view getter returning the _beneficiary address.
Public view getter returning the _releaseTime timestamp.
Public view getter returning the _lockInitiated flag.
Public view function comparing block.timestamp with _releaseTime to report whether funds can be withdrawn.
Public view function that calls token.balanceOf(address(this)) via the IERC20 token parameter.
Public function extending the lock: requires lock initiated, caller is the beneficiary and newReleaseTime is greater than _releaseTime, then writes _releaseTime.
Public function that transfers the full token balance held by the contract to the beneficiary using SafeERC20.safeTransfer after time checks.
Derived constructor forwarding the beneficiary argument to the TokenTimelock base constructor.
Caller-controlled address used for the beneficiary authorization checks in initiateLock and increaseLock.
Miner/validator-influenced block timestamp used in initiateLock, unlocked and release time comparisons.
External token.safeTransfer(_beneficiary, amount) call inside release that hands control to the token contract before transaction completion.
beneficiary address argument of TokenTimelock constructor.
releaseTime uint256 argument of initiateLock.
newReleaseTime uint256 argument of increaseLock.
token IERC20 argument of release, the token transferred to the beneficiary.
token IERC20 argument of holdings, only queried for its balance.
Local uint256 amount in release holding the contract token balance to be transferred.

edges.reason: Constructor parameter beneficiary is stored into the contract state during construction.
Constructor writes the beneficiary argument into _beneficiary.
initiateLock authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender against _beneficiary, so caller identity controls execution.
increaseLock authorizes the caller by comparing msg.sender against _beneficiary, so caller identity controls execution.
initiateLock requires releaseTime > block.timestamp, making the outcome dependent on the block timestamp.
unlocked compares block.timestamp with _releaseTime, making the returned value timestamp dependent.
release requires block.timestamp >= _releaseTime, making release eligibility dependent on the block timestamp.
initiateLock reads _beneficiary as the authorization reference for msg.sender.
increaseLock reads _beneficiary as the authorization reference for msg.sender.
release reads _beneficiary and uses it as the transfer recipient.
initiateLock reads and writes _lockInitiated to guard single initiation.
increaseLock requires _lockInitiated to be true before extending the lock.
release requires _lockInitiated to be true before transferring tokens.
releaseTime getter returns the _releaseTime state variable.
unlocked compares block.timestamp against _releaseTime.
increaseLock reads and writes _releaseTime when extending the lock.
release reads _releaseTime to validate that the unlock time has passed.
releaseTime parameter flows through initiateLock into the _releaseTime state variable.
newReleaseTime parameter flows through increaseLock into the _releaseTime state variable.
initiateLock writes the validated releaseTime into _releaseTime.
initiateLock sets _lockInitiated to true after the timestamp is stored.
increaseLock overwrites _releaseTime with the larger newReleaseTime.
holdings queries token.balanceOf(address(this)) using the token parameter.
release queries the token parameter balance before transferring.
release assigns token.balanceOf(address(this)) to the local amount variable.
The local amount is passed as the value of the safeTransfer external call.
The token parameter is the target contract of the safeTransfer external call.
_beneficiary is passed as the recipient of the safeTransfer external call.
release executes the external token transfer, transferring control to an untrusted token contract.
The external safeTransfer call returns control to release, allowing the callee to re-enter during the transfer.
TwittelonInuTimelock constructor invokes the TokenTimelock base constructor with the beneficiary.

normalization_plan.reason: The constructor parameter beneficiary is immediately assigned to _beneficiary by the constructor and has no independent identity.
The releaseTime parameter only feeds initiateLock's validation and the _releaseTime assignment, so it is folded into the function.
The newReleaseTime parameter only feeds increaseLock's validation and _releaseTime update, so it is folded into the function.
The token IERC20 parameter is used only by release to query balance and perform the safeTransfer call.
The token IERC20 parameter is used only by holdings to query token.balanceOf(address(this)).
The local amount variable is derived from the token balance and is consumed solely as the value of the safeTransfer unsafe operation.
